explore.rule: lowest val NLL over every val record

final.rule: B-i or B-ii: lower val NLL at the best B-i configuration

lambda.rule: lowest val MAD_neg among λ ∈ {0.1, 0.3} with val accuracy ≥ that of λ = 0 (seed 0) − 0.01

steps.rule: largest of {2000, 3000, 4000, 6000} with 5 waves x steps x (median exploration minutes / 600) <= 180 min; throughput only
